definitions.explanation: The company or entity that produces or manufactures a product. Commonly found on product packaging and labels.

examples.japanese: {製造元|せいぞうもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせた→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧。
{製造元|せいぞうもと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ラベル→ラベル：00348_raberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いてあります→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The manufacturer is written on the back of the label.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{製造元|せいぞうもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全品|ぜんぴん}→全品：26366_zenpin⟧⟦リコール→リコール：29697_rikooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Defective products were found, so the manufacturer announced a full recall.

notes:
USAGE:
{製造元|せいぞうもと} specifically refers to the entity that manufactures a product, as opposed to the seller or distributor. It is a standard term found on product packaging in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製造元|せいぞうもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧ (to contact the manufacturer)
- {製造元|せいぞうもと}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧ (manufacturer unknown)
- {製造元|せいぞうもと}⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧ (shipped directly from the manufacturer)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{販売元|はんばいもと}→販売元：24327_hanbaimoto⟧: seller, distributor
- {製造者|せいぞうしゃ}: manufacturer (person/entity)
- ⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: maker (loanword)
